## Why it matters internationally

The Jang lab represents the strong Korean school of nanophotonic
thermal-emission control, notably solution-processable radiative-cooling
coatings for photovoltaics — engineered emissivity aimed at
manufacturability.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** engineered thermal emission of nanophotonic coatings
- **Spectral range:** solar + mid-infrared bands
- **Methodology:** Nanophotonics including radiative cooling for photovoltaics, with solution-processable solar-transparent mesoporous nanoparticle coatings; thermal-emission control.

**Application domains:** radiative cooling for photovoltaics · nanophotonic thermal emitters.
